selection: 8 categories x 2 predetermined distinct topics; within stratum lowest SHA256(seed:id); no outcome-based sample selection
testPolicy: Do not inspect baseline-holdout quality until final configuration is frozen.
stages: A: baseline vs five structural profiles, all other options fixed
B1: chosen profile, candidateK 10/20/40, other options fixed
B2: chosen profile and candidateK, keywordWeight .25/.5/1, other options fixed
C: chosen parameters, dedicated reranker off/on
D: chosen retrieval pipeline, uuid/compact citation style only
E: full dev confirmation, including all failed rows; reuse identical completed selected subset
F: freeze final configuration before looking at or running independent test
selectionRule: Retrieval stages maximize mean vector/hybrid macro Recall, then mean MRR. Retain control when Recall gain < .02 and MRR gain < .03; never trade >.005 Recall for MRR. Ties keep control. Citation style requires lower error count without worse retrieved evidence; unreviewed answer correctness remains null. Final adoption requires confirmation on all dev, otherwise retain original defaults and report experimental alternatives.
reporting: Each e2e variant uses the same 16-question sample and reports Recall/MRR, errors, mean/P50/P95 retrieval and total latency, actual usage/coverage. Retrieval-only diagnostics are separately labelled and never represented as end-to-end results.
